name: forgejo-mcp
description: Forgejo MCP server (forgejo-mcp, stdio) for one Codeberg or self-hosted Forgejo instance; prompts for the host and an access token kept in secure storage.

forgejo_host.title: Forgejo host
forgejo_host.description: Hostname of your Codeberg or self-hosted Forgejo instance, without scheme or path, for example codeberg.org

forgejo_token.title: Forgejo access token
forgejo_token.description: Access token from Settings > Applications on your instance. Grant the least scope the work needs; read-only use needs only read scopes.
